# oriz-diagram — full site content

> Free online Mermaid diagram editor. Diagram-as-code in your browser: write flowcharts, sequence, ER, Gantt, and class diagrams as text, render them live, and export clean SVG or PNG. 100% client-side, no upload, no signup, free.

Live app: https://diagram.oriz.in
Source: https://github.com/chirag127/oriz-diagram
License: MIT

## Hero

Free online Mermaid diagram editor. Write flowcharts, sequence, ER, Gantt and class diagrams as text — render live, export clean SVG or PNG. 100% in your browser. No upload. No signup.

Primary action: open the editor. Supported diagram types: flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, class, plus optional AI.

## What it is

oriz-diagram is a diagram-as-code studio — a live Mermaid editor. You type a diagram in text and watch it render instantly in a split code/preview layout. Export the result as SVG (vector) or PNG (2x raster). It ships one-click templates for the common diagram types, and an optional AI helper that converts plain English into Mermaid or fixes broken syntax.

Everything runs in the browser. Rendering, validation, and export are all client-side; your diagram source never leaves your machine. It works offline once loaded.

## Features

- Live Mermaid editor: split code / preview panes; renders as you type (debounced); zoom controls on the preview.
- Templates: flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, and class — one click each to load a working starting diagram.
- Export: SVG (clean vector) and PNG (2x raster generated from the SVG via canvas).
- Drag-drop: drop a .mmd or .txt file onto the preview to load its contents.
- Optional AI: describe a process in plain English and get Mermaid code back; or run "fix syntax" on a parse error. Powered by @chirag127/oz-ai (g4f multi-provider failover, no API key). If AI is down, the editor still works.
- Persistence: your last diagram is remembered in localStorage.
- Instant first paint: the heavy Mermaid renderer is lazy-loaded on first render only.

## Diagram templates

Flowchart:

```
flowchart TD
    A([Start]) --> B{Input valid?}
    B -- Yes --> C[Process data]
    B -- No --> D[Show error]
    C --> E[(Save result)]
    D --> F([End])
    E --> F
```

Sequence:

```
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant A as App
    participant S as Server
    U->>A: Click export
    A->>S: POST /render
    S-->>A: 200 SVG
    A-->>U: Download file
```

ER diagram:

```
erDiagram
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    ORDER ||--|{ LINE_ITEM : contains
    PRODUCT ||--o{ LINE_ITEM : "listed in"
```

Gantt:

```
gantt
    title Project timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Design
    Research   :done,    r1, 2026-01-01, 5d
    Wireframes :active,  w1, after r1, 4d
```

Class:

```
classDiagram
    class Shape { +String id +area() float }
    class Circle { +float radius +area() float }
    Shape <|-- Circle
```

## How to use

1. Open the editor at https://diagram.oriz.in.
2. Pick a template (flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, class) or start typing Mermaid text.
3. Watch the preview render live as you type.
4. Optionally click the AI button to turn English into Mermaid, or fix a syntax error.
5. Export as SVG or PNG, or drop a .mmd/.txt file to load an existing diagram.

## Privacy

No backend, no API keys, no analytics on your diagrams. Everything is computed locally. AI calls happen only when you click an AI button, and go to g4f providers via the shared client; your other diagrams never touch a network.

## FAQ

Is it free? Yes, completely free, no signup.
Do I need an account? No. There is no login and no upload.
Where is my diagram stored? Only in your browser (localStorage). Nothing is uploaded.
Does the AI need a key? No. AI uses g4f multi-provider failover with no key; the editor works even when AI is unavailable.
What can I export? SVG (vector) and PNG (2x raster).
Which diagram types are supported? Everything Mermaid supports, with templates for flowchart, sequence, ER, Gantt, and class.

## Tech

Client-only Astro static build, React 19 islands, Tailwind v4, the mermaid library, and shared @chirag127/oz-* packages (oz-ai for AI, oz-file for file handling, oz-tokens-base for tokens, oz-chrome for shell). PWA-installable. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
